agentic.summary: Audit of 42-turn conversation: main issue is a verification failure (agent confirmed a return before the account was pulled up). No other policy violations found in the agent's turns.

findings.quote: Ok, then you can return it, no charge
findings.explanation: Agent confirmed that the customer could return the item (an order/return action) before the account was pulled up. The system later logs 'Account has been pulled up for Norman Bouchard.' at turn 22, so the required verification occurred after the agent's confirmation. The policy requires pulling up the account before any account or order action (refunds/returns); taking or confirming the action without prior verification is a major violation.

full.summary: Audit of a customer support conversation for compliance with policy. Found a major verification violation (confirming a return/no charge before the account was pulled up) and a minor personal data over-collection (requesting street address when not needed). No other violations detected.

findings.quote: Ok, your purchase is validated, now I need your street address
findings.explanation: The agent asked for the customer's street address although for an in-store return the street address is not required. The request was made before the customer selected the return method (the agent asked for the address at turn 28, and the return method was chosen at turn 32), so this collects more personal data than the task needed.

findings.quote: Ok, then you can return it, no charge
findings.explanation: The agent confirmed that the customer could return the item and that there would be no charge before the account was pulled up. The transcript shows the system pulled up the account at turn 22 ('Account has been pulled up for Norman Bouchard.'), so this is an account/order action confirmed without the required prior verification.

findings.quote: Ok, then you can return it, no charge
findings.explanation: Agent confirmed that the customer can return the item with no charge (an account/order action) before pulling up the account or verifying identity. Policy requires full verification (username, email address and order ID) before returns are approved; the agent only requested those details afterwards (turn 19). Confirming an action before verification is a major violation.
